title: Exact augmented sheafified free presheaf Čech nerve
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category with morphisms in universe $v$, let $J$ be a Grothendieck topology, and assume sheafification of $v$-valued abelian presheaves exists [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let $f:E\to P$ be a locally surjective map of $v$-valued presheaves of sets. Let $N_n=E\times_P\cdots\times_PE$ with $n+1$ factors and let $A_n=(\mathbb Z[N_n])^\#$, with alternating-face differential $d_{n+1}:A_{n+1}\to A_n$ [def-sc-presheaf-cech-complex]. There exist abelian sheaves $K_n$, maps $i_n:K_n\to A_n$ and $p_n:A_{n+1}\to K_n$, and an isomorphism $e_0:A_0\simeq(\mathbb Z[E])^\#$, such that $0\to K_0\xrightarrow{i_0}A_0\xrightarrow{Z[f]\circ e_0}(\mathbb Z[P])^\#\to0$ and $0\to K_{n+1}\xrightarrow{i_{n+1}}A_{n+1}\xrightarrow{p_n}K_n\to0$ are short exact, and $i_n\circ p_n=d_{n+1}$ for every $n\geq0$. No coefficient sheaf, cohomological degree, or Ext vanishing is assumed.

source.place: Tag 01GC (lemma-compare-cosk0), with Tag 079Z (presheaf descent); read the published Stacks pages.

proof.text: At each object replace the target by the image of f, which leaves its nerve unchanged. Apply the free set-nerve contraction with ring Z from [lem-weil-pbc-set-cech-nerve-free-resolution]. Evaluation computes presheaf kernels and cokernels objectwise. Thus the augmented free presheaf complex resolves the free abelian presheaf on that image.

Sheafification preserves finite limits (Mathlib Sites/LeftExact) and colimits as a left adjoint, and hence is exact on abelian presheaves. Local surjectivity identifies the sheafified free image with the sheafified free target. The degree-zero nerve identification gives e0, with the augmentation precisely Z[f] composed with e0.

Take the kernel of the augmentation for K0 and successively the kernels of the induced maps onto preceding syzygies. Exactness supplies the epic factorizations p_n of d_(n+1); kernel inclusions supply i_n. The kernel universal property gives i_(n+1) followed by p_n equal to zero, and the factorizations give all asserted short exact sequences.
